### Describe your idea

Enter your business idea and answer 5 quick questions about your goals, team, and constraints. Takes under 3 minutes.

### Specialist AI agents run in sequence

Each section reasons through your specific market, numbers, and competitors for several minutes before writing a word — this is analysis, not autocomplete. Typically 45–90 minutes for Full mode, 20–35 for Lite.

### Download a 100–160 page PDF

Consulting-grade output you can share with investors, partners, or clients. Lite blueprints run 60–90 pages; full blueprints and business plans run 100–160 pages.

## Every angle of your business, covered.

Four strategic pillars — each one producing substantive, specific analysis adapted to your market, your model, and your industry.

~10 pages per section on average

60–90 pages lite blueprint

100–160 pages full & business plan

### Market & Opportunity

Understand your landscape — who you compete against, how big the opportunity is, and who your customer actually is.

- 4–6 named competitors with pricing and positioning gaps
- Market sizing — TAM, SAM, SOM for your specific niche
- Customer personas — who buys, why, and what job they hire you for

### Revenue & Growth

Model your business economics — how you price, how you acquire customers, and whether the numbers actually work.

- Pricing model with unit economics — CAC, LTV, payback period
- Acquisition channels and 90-day launch sequence
- Revenue projections with break-even and sensitivity analysis

### Product & Operations

Map what you're building or running — the experience, the systems, and the infrastructure that deliver your value.

- Product design, customer experience, and key service flows
- Technical or operational systems and tool stack
- Analytics, compliance, and security requirements

### Risk & Roadmap

Surface blockers before they cost you. Includes an Adversarial Review that argues the case against your idea, and Kill Conditions — the specific things that, if true, mean you shouldn't build it.

- Critical blockers and assumptions that need validating
- Prioritized issue tracker — blockers, gaps, nice-to-haves
- Investor-ready executive summary and MVP scope

## The deliverable that turns clients into retainers.

In 90 minutes, you deliver a complete strategic blueprint your client will reference all year. Every deliverable — PDF, portal, workspace — carries your brand.

Your client gets a complete strategic blueprint — competitor analysis, financial projections, go-to-market strategy, and a launch roadmap. The kind of strategic depth that earns their trust, deepens the relationship, and gives them a reason to keep you on.

## When Foray isn't for you

We'd rather tell you upfront than have you disappointed.

You need a complete business plan today

Foray generates the strategic blueprint — market, model, competitors, risks. A formal business plan for investors or banks may need additional formatting and an accountant's stamp.

You want someone to validate your idea

Foray stress-tests your idea, but it won't tell you it's great if the numbers don't support it. If you need reassurance, this isn't the right tool.

Your industry is highly regulated and niche

Healthcare, legal, and financial services require domain-specific compliance knowledge. The blueprint will cover what it can, but verified regulatory data in narrow verticals is often unavailable.
